description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) what is the sequence of events between now and Jesus second coming?  I would like to know what’s happening so I can share it with others.  Is the latter rain being poured out yet?
. 
2.) "I’d like to know what is meant in John 10:18 where Jesus said he had the authority to lay down his life and to take it back again. 
It seems clear in Galatians 1:1 and in Romans 6:4 and in many places in the book of acts that it was God the father that raised Jesus from the dead. 
So what is meant by I have the authority to take my life back? Is it also then correct to say that it was the father that raised Jesus from the dead, Not Jesus raising Himself?"
.
3.) I know when I repent my sin goes into the sanctuary.  Does that mean I am not truly forgiven until the Day of Atonement is over and Michael stands up?  My sins remain if they are in the sanctuary, scary to realize my sin exists even after I repent.  I need guidance in understanding this.
.
.
